ekāhamata.p: [ ekāha + mata ] (ti) Google Translate One day he died. One day after death

R:
ekāhamata：ဧကာဟ-မတ （တိ）
သေ၍တစ်ရက် ရှိပြီးသည်။

CPD: ekâha-dvīha , m. n., one or two days; ~ aṃ (" for one or two days" ) pāsāde yeva ahosi Ja l 292, 17 ; ~ aṃ tatth' eva ahosi, V 12, 19 ; ~ am pi ekato avutthapubbaṃ, Vl 311, 1 '; — ° '-accaya , m., the end of one or two days; ~ ena ( "after one or two days had passed" ) , Ja l 253, 22 ; 255, 14 ; 292, 18 ; ll 298, 14 ; V 285, 9 ; 298, 14 ; — ° -matta , mfn., lasting only one or two days; tassa taṃ ~ am eva ahosi, Ja V 13, 7 ( "this lasted him only one or two days" ) ; — ° âdi , mfn., one or two days or more; Sp 722, 19 ( ~ -vasena).

R:
ekāhaparivāsa：ဧကာဟ-ပရိဝါသ （ပ）
တစ်ရက်နေသော ပရိဝါသ်။

CPD: [ ekâhaṃ , in ~ aṃ bhante at Vin l 82, 34 and lll 7, 12 is a sandhi form (ekaṃ ahaṃ bhante, Sp 183, 4 )]
NCP: acc. adv. | ekaaha.m for one day, during one day See also: eka
instr. adv. | ekaahena in one day, in a single day; during that same day See also: eka
